CI.nameNote: The government asks that Côte d’Ivoire not be translated; Ivory Coast is still common in English.

CY.nameNote: The northern part is administered by the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, recognised only by Türkiye.

CZ.nameNote: Czechia is the short name adopted in 2016; Czech Republic remains the formal name.

alsoKnownAs: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

MK.nameNote: Renamed North Macedonia in 2019 following the Prespa agreement.

alsoKnownAs: Republic of the Union of Myanmar
MM.nameNote: Myanmar since 1989; some governments and media still use Burma.

alsoKnownAs: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

PS.nameNote: UN observer state. Referred to as the State of Palestine, the Palestinian Territories, or West Bank and Gaza depending on the source.

alsoKnownAs: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Principe

TR.nameNote: Türkiye is the name used at the UN since 2022; Turkey remains widely used in English.

TW.nameNote: Self-governed as the Republic of China. Recognised under different names depending on the recognising state or organisation (Taiwan, Republic of China, Chinese Taipei, Taiwan Province of China).

VA.nameNote: The Holy See is the UN observer entity; Vatican City is the territory it governs.

XK.nameNote: Declared independence in 2008. Recognised by a majority but not all UN member states; some states refer to it as the Autonomous Province of Kosovo and Metohija.
